# Meta-Learning Pack: Signal, Not Volume

Forward memory should change how the next session opens—not decorate a diary.

## Store lean truths

Keep durable, environment-specific patterns: sequences that worked, flags that matter, ordering bugs observed once and verified.

## Eligibility filter

Omit generic tutorials, ephemeral identifiers, and anything recoverable from history without loss. If a note cannot influence the first actions of a future run, rewrite or delete it.

## Compression protocol

One current truth per topic; edit lines in place. When reality updates, replace—do not append contradictions.

## Pair with execution

Batch independent discovery. Keep diffs tight to the ask. Validate with project checks.

## Anti-patterns

Contradictory scrolls, mood commentary without commands, unverified guesses stated as facts.

## Closure

Notes stabilize; execution quality improves; the notebook stays navigable.
